en.t: Aelia Eudoxia receives the imperial title Augusta
en.s: Aelia Eudoxia, the wife of Eastern Roman emperor Arcadius, received the imperial title Augusta on 9 January 400.
en.n: This entry concerns the formal imperial title, rather than the start of her marriage to Arcadius.

zh.t: 艾利娅·尤多克西娅获授“奥古斯塔”尊号
zh.s: 400年1月9日，东罗马皇帝阿卡狄乌斯的妻子艾利娅·尤多克西娅获授“奥古斯塔”这一皇室尊号。
zh.n: 此条记录涉及正式授予皇室尊号，并非她与阿卡狄乌斯结婚的日期。

en.t: Twelfth Council of Toledo: King Erwig of the Visigoths initiates a council in which he implements diverse measures against the Jews in Spain
en.s: The Twelfth Council of Toledo, held in Toledo, Spain, was initiated on 9 January 681 by the Visigothic King Erwig, who was elected king in 680. One of its first actions was to release the population from the laws of Wamba and recognise Erwig, anathematising all who opposed him. The Council was attended by thirty eight bishops, four abbots, and five palatine officials.

zh.t: 第十二次托莱多会议：西哥特国王埃尔维格召开会议，实施针对西班牙犹太人的多项措施
zh.s: 681年1月9日，西哥特国王埃尔维格在西班牙托莱多召开第十二次托莱多会议。他于680年被推选为国王。会议最初采取的措施之一，是解除万巴所颁法律对民众的约束，承认埃尔维格的王位，并对所有反对者施以绝罚。38名主教、4名修道院院长和5名宫廷官员出席了会议。

en.s: The 1038 Dingxiang earthquake devastated present-day Shanxi Province, northern China on 9 January. At least 32,300 people died across the province when the Ms 7.25 earthquake struck Dingxiang and Xinxian counties. In Xinzhou, about 19,742 people died and 5,655 were injured. More than 50,000 livestock also perished. About 759 were killed in Guoxian County and in present-day Taiyuan, 1,890 people died.
en.n: This entry records the local date, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.t: 1038年定襄地震
zh.s: 1038年1月9日，中国北方今山西省一带遭到强震破坏。地震袭击定襄、忻县，面波震级为7.25级，全省至少32,300人死亡。其中，忻州约有19,742人死亡、5,655人受伤，另有超过50,000头牲畜死亡。崞县约759人遇难，今太原一带有1,890人死亡。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的当地日期。

en.t: Jin forces capture the Song capital Bianjing
en.s: Jin forces captured Bianjing, the Song capital now known as Kaifeng, on 9 January 1127. The fall of the city was a major stage of the Jingkang incident.
en.n: This entry records the fall of the capital, rather than assigning every stage of the wider Jingkang incident to one day.

zh.t: 金军攻陷宋朝都城汴京
zh.s: 1127年1月9日，金军攻陷宋朝都城汴京，即今天的开封。这是靖康之变的重要阶段。
zh.n: 此条记录涉及都城陷落，并未将靖康之变的所有阶段都归于同一天。

en.s: Digunai (24 February 1122 – 15 December 1161), also known by his sinicised name Wanyan Liang and his formal title Prince of Hailing (海陵王, Hǎilíng Wáng), was the fourth emperor of the Jurchen-led Jin dynasty of China. He was the second son of Wanyan Zonggan, the eldest son of the dynastic founder Wanyan Aguda (Emperor Taizu).

zh.t: 完颜亮即位
zh.s: 迪古乃，汉名完颜亮，正式封号海陵王，生于1122年2月24日，卒于1161年12月15日，是中国女真族建立的金朝第四位皇帝。他是完颜宗干的次子；宗干则是金朝开国君主完颜阿骨打（金太祖）的长子。

en.s: In late 1187, the Ayyubids, led by Saladin, besieged the Hospitallers fortress of Belvoir Castle for an entire year before the Ayyubid forces were successful.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 贝尔沃城堡围城战
zh.s: 1187年底，萨拉丁率领阿尤布王朝军队围攻医院骑士团的贝尔沃城堡。围城持续整整一年，阿尤布军队最终攻克城堡。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The trial of Joan of Arc, a French military leader under Charles VII during the Hundred Years' War, began on 9 January 1431 and ended with her execution on 30 May. The trial is one of the most famous in history, becoming the subject of many books and films. Joan was captured during the siege of Compiègne in 1430 by Burgundian forces and subsequently sold to their English allies.

zh.t: 贞德受审
zh.s: 贞德是百年战争期间效力于查理七世的法国军事领袖。对她的审判始于1431年1月9日，并于5月30日以处决告终。这是历史上最著名的审判之一，成为许多书籍和电影的题材。1430年，贞德在贡比涅围城战期间被勃艮第军队俘获，随后被卖给其英格兰盟友。

en.s: David's Rebellion (Finnish: Davidin/Daavidin kapina), also known as the Peasants' Revolt of 1438, was a peasant revolt in the Kingdom of Sweden that took place from 1438 to 1439 in Upper Satakunta, Finland. The uprising spread from Vesilahti to Lempäälä and was led by David of Ania, also called Crazy David of Upper Satakunta, a peasant leader who mobilized resistance in response to increasing tax burdens.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 大卫起义
zh.s: 大卫起义又称1438年农民起义，于1438年至1439年发生在当时属于瑞典王国的芬兰上萨塔昆塔地区。起义由韦西拉赫蒂扩展至莱姆派莱，领袖是阿尼亚的大卫，又称上萨塔昆塔的“疯人大卫”。这位农民领袖因税负不断增加而组织民众反抗。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The battle of Kolding took place on 9 January 1644 outside Kolding in Jutland. In the opening engagement of the Torstenson War, a Swedish cavalry force under Torsten Stålhandske scattered a Danish detachment led by Frederik von Buchwald.

zh.t: 科灵战役（1644年）
zh.s: 1644年1月9日，托尔斯滕森战争的首场交战发生在日德兰半岛科灵城外。托尔斯滕·斯托尔汉斯克率领瑞典骑兵，击溃了弗雷德里克·冯·布赫瓦尔德指挥的一支丹麦分遣队。

en.s: The battle of Bovey Heath took place on 9 January 1646 at Bovey Tracey and Bovey Heath (about 10 miles (16 km) south-west of Exeter in Devon, England) during the First English Civil War. A Parliamentarian cavalry detachment under the command of Oliver Cromwell surprised and routed the Lord Wentworth's Royalist camp. After a series of losses for the Royalists in the southwest of England, they had retreated to Exeter and beyond.

zh.t: 博维荒原战役
zh.s: 1646年1月9日，第一次英国内战中的博维荒原战役，在德文郡博维特雷西及博维荒原展开，地点在埃克塞特西南约十英里、即16公里。奥利弗·克伦威尔指挥的一支议会派骑兵分队，突袭并击溃温特沃思勋爵的保王派营地。此前保王派在英格兰西南部接连失利，已退往埃克塞特及更远地区。

en.t: An earthquake strikes Sicily before the devastating January 11 mainshock
en.s: A damaging earthquake struck Sicily on 9 January 1693. It preceded the larger earthquake of 11 January that devastated parts of southern Italy and Malta.
en.n: This entry records the January 9 foreshock, rather than the January 11 mainshock.

zh.t: 西西里发生地震，先于1月11日的毁灭性主震
zh.s: 1693年1月9日，西西里发生破坏性地震。两天后的1月11日，更强烈的地震重创意大利南部部分地区及马耳他。
zh.n: 此条记录涉及1月9日的前震，并非1月11日的主震。

en.s: The Battle of Barari Ghat बुराडी घाट was a military engagement between the Durrani-Rohilla Afghans and the Marathas army in which the Maratha army was defeated and its leader killed in battle.

zh.t: 巴拉里渡口战役
zh.s: 巴拉里渡口战役发生在杜兰尼—罗希拉阿富汗军队与马拉塔军队之间。马拉塔军队战败，其统帅在战斗中阵亡。

en.s: The 1779 South Carolina gubernatorial election was held on January 9, 1779, in order to elect the Governor of South Carolina. Former Governor John Rutledge was elected by the South Carolina General Assembly as he ran unopposed. The exact number of votes cast in this election is unknown.

zh.t: 1779年美国南卡罗来纳州州长选举
zh.s: 1779年1月9日，南卡罗来纳州举行州长选举。前州长约翰·拉特利奇因无人竞争，经州议会选举当选。此次选举的确切票数不详。

en.t: Connecticut ratifies the United States Constitution
en.s: Connecticut ratified the United States Constitution on 9 January 1788, becoming the fifth state to do so.
en.n: This entry records ratification, rather than the date the Constitution later took effect.

zh.t: 康涅狄格州批准美国宪法
zh.s: 1788年1月9日，康涅狄格州批准美国宪法，成为第五个批准宪法的州。
zh.n: 此条记录涉及批准宪法，并非宪法后来生效的日期。

en.s: The Treaty of Jassy, signed at Jassy (Iași) in Moldavia (presently in Romania), was a pact between the Russian and Ottoman Empires ending the Russo-Turkish War of 1787–92 and confirming Russia's increasing dominance in the Black Sea. The treaty was signed on 9 January 1792 by Grand Vizier Koca Yusuf Pasha and Prince Bezborodko (who had succeeded Prince Potemkin as the head of the Russian delegation when Potemkin died). The Treaty of Jassy formally recognized the Russian Empire's annexation of the Crimean Khanate via the Treaty of Küçük Kaynarca of 1783 and transferred Yedisan (the territory between Dniester and Bug rivers) to Russia making the Dniester the Russo-Turkish frontier in Europe, and leaving the Asiatic frontier (Kuban River) unchanged.

zh.t: 《雅西条约》签订
zh.s: 1792年1月9日，俄罗斯帝国与奥斯曼帝国在摩尔达维亚的雅西，今罗马尼亚境内，签订《雅西条约》，结束1787—1792年俄土战争，并确认俄罗斯在黑海日益占据优势。签字者为大维齐尔科贾·优素福帕夏，以及接替已去世的波将金、担任俄方代表团团长的别兹博罗德科亲王。条约正式承认俄罗斯吞并克里米亚汗国，并把德涅斯特河与南布格河之间的叶迪桑地区割让俄罗斯，使德涅斯特河成为两国在欧洲的边界，亚洲的库班河边界则不变。原文将此前相关条约记为1783年的《库楚克开纳吉条约》。

en.t: William Pitt introduces income tax to finance Britain’s war against France
en.s: On 9 January 1799, British prime minister William Pitt the Younger introduced an income tax to help finance the war against France. The tax was graduated, reaching a rate of two shillings in the pound, or 10 per cent, for the highest income band.
en.n: The two-shilling rate was the top rate, rather than a flat rate paid by every taxpayer.

zh.t: 小威廉·皮特开征所得税，为英国对法战争筹款
zh.s: 1799年1月9日，英国首相小威廉·皮特开征所得税，以帮助支付对法国作战的开支。这项税采用累进税率，最高收入档每英镑征收两先令，即10%。
zh.n: 每英镑两先令是最高档税率，并非所有纳税人统一适用的税率。

en.s: The Battle of Clarines (Spanish: Batalla de Clarines) took place during the Venezuelan War of Independence. Royalist forces attacked a north-bound force from the Third Republic of Venezuela near the town of Clarines. The outnumbered and poorly armed Royalists secured a victory against the Patriot rebels.

zh.t: 克拉里内斯战役
zh.s: 克拉里内斯战役发生于委内瑞拉独立战争期间。保王派在克拉里内斯镇附近袭击了一支向北行进的委内瑞拉第三共和国部队。尽管人数较少、武器简陋，保王派仍击败了爱国派起义军。

en.t: The Portuguese prince Pedro I of Brazil decides to stay in Brazil against the orders of the Portuguese King João VI, beginning the Brazilian independence process
en.s: Dom Pedro I (12 October 1798 – 24 September 1834), known in Brazil and in Portugal as "the Liberator" (Portuguese: o Libertador) or "the Soldier King" (o Rei Soldado) in Portugal, was the founder and first ruler of the Empire of Brazil from 1822 to 1831 (under the name of Pedro I) and King of Portugal in 1826 (under the name of Pedro IV).

zh.t: 葡萄牙王子佩德罗违抗国王若昂六世的命令，决定留在巴西，开启巴西独立进程
zh.s: 佩德罗一世生于1798年10月12日，卒于1834年9月24日，在巴西和葡萄牙被称为“解放者”，在葡萄牙还被称为“军人国王”。他是巴西帝国的建立者和首位统治者，1822年至1831年以佩德罗一世之名在位，1826年又以佩德罗四世之名担任葡萄牙国王。

en.s: The Battle of Itaparica was fought in the then province of Bahia from January 7 to 9, 1823, between the Brazilian Army and Armada and the Portuguese Army and Navy during the Brazilian War of Independence. Despite the fact that the independence of Brazil had been proclaimed by Prince Regent Pedro on 7 September 1822, the armed struggle continued in Bahia, with the confrontation of Portuguese resistance.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 伊塔帕里卡战役
zh.s: 1823年1月7日至9日，巴西独立战争期间，巴西陆海军与葡萄牙陆海军在当时的巴伊亚省交战，史称伊塔帕里卡战役。尽管摄政王佩德罗已于1822年9月7日宣布巴西独立，巴伊亚的武装斗争仍在继续，巴西方面持续对抗葡萄牙的抵抗力量。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The 1833–34 Massachusetts gubernatorial election consisted of a popular election (direct election) held on November 11, 1833, and a legislative vote held in January 1834. The task of electing the governor fell to the Massachusetts General Court because no candidate received the constitutionally required majority of the popular vote. National Republican Governor Levi Lincoln Jr. did not run for a tenth term in office.
en.n: This entry records the house votes, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.t: 1833—1834年马萨诸塞州州长选举
zh.s: 1833—1834年马萨诸塞州州长选举包括1833年11月11日举行的民众直接投票，以及1834年1月举行的州议会投票。由于无人获得宪法规定的过半民众选票，选出州长的任务转交州议会。国民共和党现任州长小利瓦伊·林肯未竞逐第十个任期。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的州众议院投票日期。

en.s: The Battle of La Mesa of the Mexican–American War occurred on 9 January 1847, in present-day Vernon, California, the day after the Battle of Rio San Gabriel during the California Campaign.

zh.t: 拉梅萨战役
zh.s: 1847年1月9日，美墨战争加利福尼亚战役中的拉梅萨战役，在今加利福尼亚州弗农发生，距圣加布里埃尔河战役仅一天。

en.s: The 1853–54 Massachusetts gubernatorial election consisted of an initial popular held on November 14, 1853, which was followed by a legislative vote that was conducted on January 9, 1854, which elected Whig Party nominee Emory Washburn. The ultimate task of electing the governor had been placed before the Massachusetts General Court because no candidate received the majority of the vote required for a candidate to be elected through the popular election.
en.n: This entry records the legislative vote, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.t: 1853—1854年马萨诸塞州州长选举
zh.s: 1853—1854年马萨诸塞州州长选举先于1853年11月14日举行民众投票，随后于1854年1月9日由州议会投票，选出辉格党候选人埃默里·沃什伯恩。由于无人获得民众直选所要求的过半票数，最终选出州长的任务转交马萨诸塞州议会。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的州议会投票日期。

en.t: British forces finally defeat Rajab Ali Khan of Chittagong
en.s: Rajab Ali Khan, also known as Havildar Rajab Ali, was a soldier of the Bengal Regiment who defected during the Sepoy Revolt of 1857. He commanded the rebels at Chittagong and was chased by British forces as far as Sylhet and Manipur.

zh.t: 英军最终击败吉大港起义军领袖拉贾卜·阿里·汗
zh.s: 拉贾卜·阿里·汗，又称哈维尔达尔·拉贾卜·阿里，原为孟加拉兵团士兵，在1857年印度士兵起义期间倒戈。他指挥吉大港的起义军，遭英军追击，直至锡尔赫特和曼尼普尔。

en.t: 1860 United States Senate special election in California
en.s: The 1860 United States Senate special election in California was held on January 9, 1860, by the California State Legislature to elect a U.S. senator (Class 1) to represent the State of California in the United States Senate. In a special joint session, Lecompton Democratic Governor Milton Latham was elected over regular Democratic former State Assemblyman Edmund Randolph and Republican attorney Oscar L. Shafter.

zh.t: 1860年美国加利福尼亚州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 1860年1月9日，加利福尼亚州议会举行联邦参议员特别选举，选出该州第一组参议员席位的代表。在两院特别联席会议上，支持莱康普顿方案的民主党州长米尔顿·莱瑟姆，击败常规民主党派前州众议员埃德蒙·伦道夫及共和党律师奥斯卡·L.沙夫特，当选联邦参议员。

en.t: Mississippi in the American Civil War
en.s: Mississippi was the second southern state to declare its secession from the United States, doing so on January 9, 1861. It joined with six other southern states to form the Confederacy on February 4, 1861. Mississippi's location along the lengthy Mississippi River made it strategically important to both the Union and the Confederacy; dozens of battles were fought in the state as armies repeatedly clashed near key towns and transportation nodes.

zh.t: 美国内战中的密西西比州
zh.s: 1861年1月9日，密西西比州宣布脱离美国，成为第二个宣布脱离联邦的南方州。同年2月4日，它与另外六个南方州组建美利坚联盟国。密西西比州沿密西西比河分布的地理位置，使其对南北双方都具有战略意义。双方军队围绕重要城镇和交通枢纽多次交战，州内发生了数十场战斗。

en.s: The Battle of Hartville was fought January 9–11, 1863, in Wright County, Missouri, as part of John S. Marmaduke's first expedition into Missouri, during the American Civil War.

zh.t: 哈特维尔战役
zh.s: 1863年1月9日至11日，美国内战中的哈特维尔战役在密苏里州赖特县展开，是约翰·S.马马杜克首次远征密苏里的组成部分。

en.s: The Battle of Villersexel took place on 9 January 1871 as part of the Franco-Prussian War. Elements of the French Armée de l'Est under General Bourbaki engaged August von Werder's Prussian forces. It resulted in a French victory.

zh.t: 维莱塞克塞勒战役
zh.s: 1871年1月9日，普法战争中的维莱塞克塞勒战役爆发。布尔巴基将军指挥的法国东方军部分部队，与奥古斯特·冯·韦尔德的普鲁士军队交战，最终法军获胜。

en.t: Umberto I becomes King of Italy
en.s: Umberto I (Italian: Umberto Ranieri Carlo Emanuele Giovanni Maria Ferdinando Eugenio di Savoia; 14 March 1844 – 29 July 1900) was King of Italy from 9 January 1878 until his assassination in 1900. zh.t: 翁贝托一世成为意大利国王

en.s: The Battle of Bear Valley was a small engagement fought in 1918 between a band of Yaquis and a detachment of United States Army soldiers. On January 9, 1918, elements of the American 10th Cavalry Regiment detected about thirty armed Yaquis in Bear Valley, Arizona, a large area that was commonly used as a passage across the international border with Mexico. A short firefight ensued, which resulted in the death of the Yaqui commander and the capture of nine others. Though the conflict was merely a skirmish, it was the last time the United States Army engaged hostile Native Americans in combat and thus has been seen as one of the final battles of the American Indian Wars.

zh.t: 熊谷战役

The election was boycotted by Hamas and Islamic Jihad.

zh.s: 2005年1月9日，巴勒斯坦在约旦河西岸及加沙地带举行自1996年以来的首次总统选举。巴解组织主席马哈茂德·阿巴斯当选巴勒斯坦民族权力机构新任总统，任期四年，接替于2004年11月11日去世的亚西尔·阿拉法特。共有七名候选人参选。阿巴斯得票率超过62%，独立候选人穆斯塔法·巴尔古提以略低于20%居第二，其余候选人远远落后。哈马斯及伊斯兰圣战组织抵制选举。

en.s: On January 9, 2005, a 27-man team of Kazakh sappers from the Kazbat engineer battalion collected 35 aerial bombs that Iraqi police had found stashed near the central military base of Al-Suwaira, located 6 miles south of Baghdad. The bombs were loaded onto transport trucks from where they would be defused at the Al-Suwaira Multinational Division Central-South army base.

zh.t: 伊拉克苏韦拉弹药堆放点爆炸
zh.s: 2005年1月9日，哈萨克斯坦Kazbat工兵营的一支27人工兵队，收集了伊拉克警方发现的35枚航空炸弹。这些炸弹藏在巴格达以南六英里的苏韦拉中央军事基地附近。炸弹被装上运输卡车，准备送至苏韦拉多国部队中南师基地拆除。

en.s: The Comprehensive Peace Agreement (CPA, Arabic: اتفاقية السلام الشامل, romanized: Ittifāqiyyah al-salām al-šāmil), also known as the Naivasha Agreement, was an accord signed on 9 January 2005, by the Sudan People's Liberation Movement (SPLM) and the Government of Sudan. The CPA was meant to end the Second Sudanese Civil War, develop democratic governance countrywide, and share oil revenues. It also set a timetable for a Southern Sudanese independence referendum.

zh.t: 苏丹《全面和平协议》
zh.s: 2005年1月9日，苏丹人民解放运动与苏丹政府签署《全面和平协议》，又称《奈瓦沙协议》。协议旨在结束第二次苏丹内战，推动全国民主治理，并分享石油收入，同时为苏丹南部的独立公投制定了时间表。

en.t: The original iPhone was introduced by Steve Jobs on January 9, 2007, in a keynote address at the Macworld Conference & Expo held in Moscone West in San Francisco, California
en.s: The iPhone is a smartphone developed and marketed by Apple as the first device in the iPhone lineup of smartphones. It features a Samsung S5L8900 SoC (90 nm), a 3.5 in multi-touch display, and a web browser (Safari). After years of rumors and speculation, it was officially announced on January 9, 2007, and was released in the United States on June 29, 2007.

zh.t: 史蒂夫·乔布斯于2007年1月9日在旧金山 Macworld 大会的主题演讲中发布第一代 iPhone
zh.s: 第一代 iPhone 由苹果公司开发和销售，是 iPhone 智能手机系列的首款设备。它配备三星 S5L8900 系统芯片（90纳米工艺）、3.5英寸多点触控屏幕及 Safari 网页浏览器。经过多年的传闻和猜测，史蒂夫·乔布斯于2007年1月9日在加利福尼亚州旧金山莫斯康尼展览中心西馆举行的 Macworld 大会暨展览会上，正式公布了这款手机。它于同年6月29日在美国发售。

en.s: In the Third battle of Elephant Pass, Elephant Pass was recaptured from the Tamil Tigers by the security forces of the Sri Lankan Army. Mahinda Rajapaksa, the president of Sri Lanka declared that Elephant Pass was captured by the army on January 9, 2009.

zh.t: 第三次象关战役
zh.s: 第三次象关战役中，斯里兰卡陆军安全部队从泰米尔猛虎组织手中夺回象关。斯里兰卡总统马欣达·拉贾帕克萨宣布，军队于2009年1月9日攻占象关。

en.s: The 2010 Eureka earthquake occurred on January 9 at 4:27:38 pm PST offshore of Humboldt County, California, United States. The magnitude was measured 6.5 on the Mw scale, and its epicenter was located offshore in the Pacific Ocean 33 miles (53 km) west of the nearest major city, Eureka, California. Additionally, there was a separate earthquake further offshore of Eureka on February 4 with a slightly lower magnitude of 5.9.
en.n: This entry records the local date, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.t: 2010年尤里卡地震
zh.s: 2010年1月9日太平洋标准时间16时27分38秒，美国加利福尼亚州洪堡县外海发生矩震级6.5级地震。震中位于太平洋，距最近的主要城市尤里卡以西约33英里（53公里）。同年2月4日，尤里卡更远处的外海还发生了另一次震级稍低、为5.9级的地震。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的当地日期。

en.s: Iran Air Flight 277 was a passenger flight which crashed near Urmia Airport, West Azerbaijan Province, Iran, on January 9, 2011. 77 of the 105 aboard died. The aircraft involved, a Boeing 727-286Adv, was operating Iran Air's scheduled domestic service from Mehrabad International Airport, Tehran, to Urmia. It crashed after a go-around was initiated during final approach, in poor weather conditions.

zh.t: 伊朗航空277号班机空难
zh.s: 2011年1月9日，伊朗航空277号班机在西阿塞拜疆省乌尔米耶机场附近坠毁，机上105人中有77人死亡。执飞的波音727-286Adv客机，执行从德黑兰梅赫拉巴德国际机场至乌尔米耶的定期国内航班。天气恶劣，飞机在最后进近阶段启动复飞后坠毁。

en.s: The 2011 Genesis was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA), that took place on January 9, 2011, at the Impact Zone in Universal Studios Florida. It was the sixth event under the Genesis chronology and the first event of the 2011 TNA PPV schedule. In October 2017, with the launch of the Global Wrestling Network, the event became available to stream on demand.

zh.t: TNA《创世纪》（2011）
zh.s: 2011年1月9日，TNA 在佛罗里达环球影城的 Impact Zone 场馆举办职业摔角按次付费赛事《创世纪》。这是第六届《创世纪》，也是 TNA 2011年付费赛事日程中的首场。2017年10月，随着环球摔角网络上线，这场赛事开始提供流媒体点播。

en.s: On 9 January 2014, an explosion occurred at a Mitsubishi Materials chemical plant in Yokkaichi, Mie, Japan, killing at least five people and injuring 17 others.

zh.t: 日本三菱综合材料化工厂爆炸
zh.s: 2014年1月9日，日本三重县四日市的一家三菱综合材料化工厂发生爆炸，造成至少五人死亡、17人受伤。

en.s: On 9 January 2015, Amedy Coulibaly, armed with a submachine gun, an assault rifle, and two Tokarev pistols, entered and attacked a Hypercacher kosher supermarket in Porte de Vincennes in Paris, France. There, Coulibaly murdered four Jewish hostages and held fifteen other hostages during a siege in which he demanded that the perpetrators of the Charlie Hebdo shooting, the Kouachi brothers, not be harmed. The siege ended when police stormed the supermarket, killing Coulibaly. The Charlie Hebdo shooting had taken place just days earlier, as did the Dammartin-en-Goële hostage crisis, in which the two Charlie Hebdo gunmen were cornered.

zh.t: 巴黎犹太食品超市人质事件
zh.s: 2015年1月9日，阿梅迪·库利巴利携冲锋枪、突击步枪及两把托卡列夫手枪，闯入法国巴黎文森门的一家Hypercacher犹太食品超市发动袭击。他杀害四名犹太人质，另扣押15人，并要求警方不得伤害《查理周刊》枪击案凶手库阿希兄弟。警方最终强攻超市，击毙库利巴利，结束围困。几天前，《查理周刊》遭到枪击；库阿希兄弟随后也在达马尔坦昂戈埃勒的人质危机中被警方包围。

en.s: The 2015 Lockdown (also known as Impact Wrestling: Lockdown) was a professional wrestling television special produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA). The show took place on January 9, 2015 at the Manhattan Center in New York, New York. It was the eleventh event under the Lockdown chronology. Unlike the previous events, this event was not held on pay-per-view (PPV) and instead, was featured as a special edition of TNA's weekly broadcast of Impact Wrestling on Destination America on February 6.

zh.t: 2015年TNA“封锁”摔角特别节目
zh.s: 2015年1月9日，TNA职业摔角联盟在美国纽约市曼哈顿中心制作电视特别节目“封锁”，又称《Impact Wrestling：封锁》。这是该系列的第十一届。与此前不同，这次赛事未采用按次付费方式，而是于2月6日，在Destination America电视台作为TNA每周节目《Impact Wrestling》的特别一期播出。

en.s: In 2015 a coup d'état was allegedly attempted in Sri Lanka by former president Mahinda Rajapaksa in order to remain in power after he had been voted out in the 2015 Sri Lankan presidential election. Rajapaksa, who was expected to easily win a third term in office lost to Maithripala Sirisena, a former ally and member of the Rajapaksa administration.

zh.t: 2015年斯里兰卡涉嫌未遂政变
zh.s: 据指控，斯里兰卡前总统马欣达·拉贾帕克萨在2015年总统选举中落败后，曾企图发动政变以继续执政。此前外界预期他能轻松赢得第三个任期，但他最终败给了昔日盟友、曾在其政府任职的迈特里帕拉·西里塞纳。

en.t: Mont-Libre Agile Learning Centre, the province of Quebec's first alternative schooling democratic learning centre to support homeschooled youth, opens in the city of Montreal
en.s: Mont-Libre Agile Learning Centre (Mont-Libre) is an independent (i.e. fee-charging) inclusive multi-age and bilingual democratic learning centre servicing children who are registered for homeschooling in Quebec, Canada. Mont-Libre was founded on January 9th, 2017. It is the first democratic learning centre of its kind in Quebec. The centre is located in the urban borough of La Petite Patrie, Montreal.

zh.t: 蒙特利尔 Mont-Libre 学习中心开办，为在家学习的青少年提供魁北克省首个此类民主教育中心
zh.s: Mont-Libre 敏捷学习中心是一所独立收费、包容不同年龄并提供双语学习的民主教育中心，服务于在加拿大魁北克省登记接受家庭教育的儿童。中心成立于2017年1月9日，是魁北克首个此类民主学习中心，位于蒙特利尔小祖国城区。

en.s: On 9 January 2020, a large group of Islamic State in the Greater Sahara militants assaulted a Nigerien military base at Chinagodrar, in Niger's Tillabéri Region. They attacked an army post in Chinagodrar, in the west of the country, in Tillabéri Region, 13 kilometres (8 miles) from the border with Mali, 210 kilometres (130 miles) north of Niamey.

zh.t: 尼日尔希纳戈德拉尔战役
zh.s: 2020年1月9日，大批“大撒哈拉伊斯兰国”武装人员，进攻尼日尔蒂拉贝里大区希纳戈德拉尔的一处军营。该哨所位于尼日尔西部，距离马里边境13公里，在首都尼亚美以北210公里。

zh.t: 2021年Impact Wrestling“创世纪”摔角赛
zh.s: 2021年1月9日，Impact Wrestling在美国田纳西州纳什维尔的Skyway Studios举办职业摔角赛事“创世纪”，仅通过Impact Plus播出。这是该系列的第12届，也是2018年后首次举办；自2013年以来，首次要求单独购买观看。赛事共进行九场比赛。

en.s: Sriwijaya Air Flight 182 was a scheduled domestic passenger flight from Jakarta to Pontianak, Indonesia. Just four minutes after departing from Soekarno–Hatta International Airport on 9 January 2021, the Boeing 737-500 entered an upset and crashed into the Java Sea off the Thousand Islands, killing all 62 people on board. A search of the area recovered wreckage, human remains, and items of clothing.

zh.t: 三佛齐航空182号班机事故
zh.s: 三佛齐航空182号班机是印度尼西亚雅加达至坤甸的定期国内客运航班。2021年1月9日，执飞的波音737-500客机从苏加诺—哈达国际机场起飞仅四分钟后便失去正常飞行姿态，坠入千岛群岛附近的爪哇海，机上62人全部遇难。搜救人员随后在事发海域发现飞机残骸、遇难者遗体及衣物。

en.s: A by-election was held on 9 January 2022 in Taichung to elect one member of the Legislative Yuan for the Taichung City Constituency II (Taichung 2) for the remaining term until 2024. Democratic Progressive Party legislator Lin Ching-yi won the by-election for Taichung 2 to replace Chen Po-wei, who was recalled on 23 October 2021.

zh.t: 2022年台中市第二选区立委补选
zh.s: 2022年1月9日，台中市第二选区举行立法委员补选，补足至2024年届满的剩余任期。民进党林静仪当选，接替于2021年10月23日遭罢免的陈柏惟。

zh.s: 2024年1月9日，厄瓜多尔爆发武装冲突，政府与多个有组织犯罪集团交战，其中最主要的是“乔内罗斯”贩毒集团。瓜亚基尔及全国其他地区广泛传出武装袭击，主要发生在监狱、市场、道路和大学。

en.s: The 2023–24 Bhutanese National Assembly election was held in two rounds on 30 November 2023 and 9 January 2024 to elect the 47 members of the National Assembly, the lower house of the Parliament of Bhutan. It was the fourth National Assembly election held under Bhutan's 2008 Constitution. Five political parties contested the first round, with the People's Democratic Party (PDP) and the Bhutan Tendrel Party (BTP) qualifying for the second round after finishing first and second respectively.

zh.t: 2023—2024年不丹国民议会选举
zh.s: 2023—2024年不丹国民议会选举分两轮举行，日期分别为2023年11月30日和2024年1月9日，选出议会下院国民议会的47名议员。这是不丹依据2008年宪法举行的第四届国民议会选举。五个政党参加首轮投票，人民民主党与缘庆党分列第一、第二，晋级第二轮。

en.s: On 29 September 2022, an indirect election for the Lebanese presidency was initiated to determine the successor of term-limited incumbent Michel Aoun, who took office on 31 October 2016. On 9 January 2025, Joseph Aoun (no relation to Michel), who had been serving as the Commander of the Lebanese Armed Forces since 9 March 2017, secured 99 votes to win the presidential election in the second round of the 13th parliamentary session.

zh.t: 2022—2025年黎巴嫩总统选举
zh.s: 2022年9月29日，黎巴嫩启动总统间接选举，为任期届满的米歇尔·奥恩选出继任者。米歇尔·奥恩于2016年10月31日就任。2025年1月9日，自2017年3月9日起担任黎巴嫩武装部队司令的约瑟夫·奥恩，在议会第13次总统选举会议的第二轮投票中获得99票，当选总统。他与米歇尔·奥恩没有亲属关系。

en.s: The 2024 Vermont lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 2024. Republican former state Senator John Rodgers defeated incumbent Progressive Lieutenant Governor David Zuckerman who was running for re-election to a fourth non-consecutive term in office. The election was held concurrently with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as elections to the United States Senate and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年佛蒙特州副州长选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日，佛蒙特州举行副州长选举。共和党籍前州参议员约翰·罗杰斯击败进步党现任副州长戴维·朱克曼；朱克曼曾中断任职，此次争取个人第四个任期。这场选举与2024年美国总统选举、联邦参议院和众议院选举，以及多项州和地方选举同时举行。
